title: Where do y’all usually spawn in your mall world dreams
content: I have only had one mall world dream in my life so far, I’m sure there’s more to come, but when I first spawned in i was in a spa that connected to an eery looking bathroom with a pool in it. I walked around the mall further and obviously saw much more, like an eerily build play place and empty kiosks. but where do you guys typically spawn?
